'''Bra'dda Lui''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served under the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was present in the [[Strike Base XR-484|Imperial Command Center]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the Empire's [[Invasion of Ossus|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

==Behind the scenes==
Bra'dda Lui serves as a vendor for [[Stimulant/Legends|stims]] on the Imperial Side at [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] within the game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''.
